run_check_readme_docs: run the script to check that all target directories contain a README.md file
run_check_doxygen_file_comments: run the script to verify all c h and cc files have a backslash file doxygen comment
run_check_documentation: run the documentation checker script against grpc source and test directories for missing docs
review_target_dirs: review the list of target directories checked for README.md files and doxygen comments
review_interesting_extensions: review the file extensions checked for doxygen file comments in the documentation checker
